_how: deck/tools/build.mjs reads this file, fills every <!--r:key-->...<!--/r--> marker in deck/index.html and docs/PITCH.md, then prints deck/Ruko-pitch.pdf. To switch to v5: set source to "public" once eval/publish.ts publishes v5 to public/eval/results.json, or keep "runs" and change the run ids below. Then rewrite the three *_note texts by hand from the new reports.

dev.label: Development set
dev.note: 96 conversations; the prompt was tuned on it

holdout.label: Held-out set 3
holdout.note: 28 conversations, written and frozen before any run

otp_note_dev: the flagged turn asked whether the customer had already shared an OTP with the caller; it was a question about a disclosure, not a request for the OTP
failure_note: Every held-out scam that got through had the same shape: no live caller, and a customer who insisted the payment was their own idea (a landlord deposit, a tower lease, a pilgrimage booking, a 'boss' on WhatsApp). v5, now under test, delays rather than releases when the evidence is not clearly genuine.
false_hold_note: Both held-out false holds were Hindi: a tax payment made while on a call with an accountant, and a son guiding his mother to pay a hospital.

live_calls.note: No live Bolna call has been measured yet; the demo video records the first one.
